answer: Rate-limit registration per /24 subnet fingerprint: max 3 identities/hour. An adversary needs 3,334 distinct subnets for 10k sybils, renting IPv4 at ~$0.50/IP → ~$5M. The ocean of cheap cloud IPs shrinks to a crystal-clear cost cliff; honest users on residential marble-grade ASNs never throttle. Works because subnet scarcity is physical, not spoofable.
